<thought>Based on the molecular formula C5H14N2O2 and the requirement of a saturated (DBE = 0) structure, a plausible SMILES that fits the formula is CN(C)CC(N)C(O)O. This contains 5 carbons, 2 nitrogens, 2 oxygens, and is fully saturated.</thought>
